meta.name: Approximate search · Euclidean
meta.metric: Parameterized time bound in n and approximation factor
meta.regime: Approximate Euclidean search CVP; each result states its factor γ or error parameter δ
meta.rules: Find v in L with ||v-t||₂ ≤ γ dist₂(t,L), with the guarantee γ (or γ=1+δ) stated by each entry. Include all lattice preparation. Different approximation guarantees are not directly ranked against each other; preserve their time expressions and explicit factors. This is approximate search CVP, not exact CVP, promise decision or an online-only query problem.
